Ava (Marketing): Heads up 48 we need final changelog link + doc live by Mon 6pm PT. Webinar invite scheduled Wed 9am PT. Can eng confirm rollout cadence?

Ravi (Eng): Yes. Proposal: 10% canary 90m, 40% 4h, full after 24h. Regions NA->EU->APAC with 2h checks.

Zoe (Product): Add automated rollback: if eval quality down >2% for 20m -> fallback. Marketing copy for rollback: 'We temporarily paused rollout to investigate'.

Leo (Docs): Will publish notes and short changelog snippet. Draft link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/releases/v1.2-draft (private).

Ava (Marketing): Need 1-line headline + 2-line webinar blurb + changelog bullets to paste.

Ravi (Eng): Changelog bullets:
- adaptive batching (beta): ~20% token cost reduction on chat flows
- KV cache hotpath perf: improved p95
- routing: staged canary + auto-fallback

Nora (Growth Ops): SDR tag/webhook set: tag=launch_webinar_2026, utm_campaign=redwood-v1.2-webinar. Flow: crm-1059.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued Wed 10:10 PT job-id job-6078-01. Will post status.

Ava (Marketing): Timeline recap: Mon 6pm PT docs live (Leo), Wed 9am invites (Ava), Wed 10:10 canary start (Eng), Wed 10:30 publish blog + signup (Marketing). Will post draft by EOD.

Ravi (Eng): Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/launch-v1.2 (ops-only). Monitoring tags: p50/p95, error, eval_quality.

Ava (Marketing): Great 4 thanks everyone, will circle back at 5pm PT for sign-off. :rocket:
